character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the snow onsen world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in outdoor stone bath in snow, wooden inn with lit windows, snowy path with lanterns; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with steam white, snow blue, lantern amber, cedar brown; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow push-in through rising steam, wide shot of a snowy mountain inn, low shot of snow falling on hot water; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
